Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Broad Technical Specification for Electro-hydraulic Operating Table 1. Surgical table should be Electro-hydraulic table with complete carb on fiber tabletop and integrated power unit suitable for MIS Surgery / CTVS / Endo-vascular and other procedure requiring intra operativ e fluoroscopic C-Arm imaging with three axis table movement. 2. It should have X-Ray facility equipped with a full length, built in X-r ay cassette tray accessible from either side of the table. 3. The top includes a 45-degree beveled edge to facilitate accessory attachment on side rail while enabling 360-degree maximum imagi ng capabilities. With side rails, width should not exceed more than 30 inches. 4. Table Top Slide (Longitudinal and Lateral Float): Should have a pro vision for longitudinal slide of at least 60 cm for superior C-arm cov erage without repositioning or reversing the patient and also allow l ateral float of at least 18 cm. 5. Trendelenburg and Reverse Trendelenburg of +/-16 degrees shoul d be possible. 6. There should be lateral tilt facility of +/- 16 degrees or more.

7. Operating position i.e. Height adjustment, Trendelenburg, Reverse Trendelenburg, Lateral Tilt, Lateral Slide, Longitudinal Slide and Flo or Locking are quickly and precisely controlled by backlit handheld Remote with symbolic position figures using low voltage system to ensure safety of the user. The remote should have position locking f acility, battery status indicator & mains power indicator. The hands et should have 4 nos. of resettable memory buttons. 8. Should have at least a 4-memory function for the settings of the O T Table positioning for ease to memorize surgeon working settings 9. Should have automatic 'Zero' positioning switch on handheld contr oller to bring all the table top positions to zero level including Heigh t. 10. Should be supplied with a cordless Bluetooth remote which should have buttons for all the movements of the OT Table. 11. The table should be equipped with an electric override control pan el embedded in the center column body with equal performance to that of the handheld controller. 12. The powered movements are actuated by an Imported Electro-hyd raulic System comprising of hydraulic motor pump with low noise le vel of less than 50 dBA and solenoid valves to assure smooth and q uiet movements 13. Tabletop length should be 200 cm (6ft) + 5%. 14. The mattress should be of high quality, covering the table's top for enhanced patient supp ort. It should have a depth of 50 mm and should be latex-free. 15. Mattress should be Flame retardant, lab test report should be attac hed. 16. The operating table should be fitted with four twin-disk 100 mm ca stors, self-compensating 4 post hydraulic floor locking system with manual release valve. 17. Maintenance free Lifting System: State-of -the-art lifting system comprising of hi-precision bearings with large contact surface which ensures the highest rigidity for heavy loads and smooth up-down movement. All bearings are permanently grease lubricated thus making t his lifting system virtually maintenance free for lifetime. 18. Non-corrosive SS304 Grade Stainless Steel base and cylindrical co vers for easy cleaning and hygiene. 19. Complete with SS304 Grade Stainless Steel side-rails, clamps and standard accessories.

20. Special accessory pack should include vascular package with catheter extension board an d AV Fistula board. 21. The Quoted model should have Test Report from NABL approved Lab for Electrical IEC 601 01-1, medical/electrical equipment for safety, IEC 60601-2-46 for safety of OT tables. 22. Manufacturer should have ISO 13485 certification issued from Any Certification Bodies reg istered with NABCB under Medical Devices Quality Management System OR Any notified b ody registered with CDSCO OR any 4-digit CE notified body. Technical Specifications: i. Table top length: 2000 mm (+/- 5%) ii. Table top width (with side-rails): Not more than 760 mm iii. Minimum Height (without padding): 750 mm iv. Maximum Height (without padding): 1000 mm or more v. Trendelenburg / Reverse Trendelenburg: 16°/16° vi. Lateral Tilt (Left/Right): 16°/16° vii. Longitudinal Slide: 600 mm or more viii. Lateral Slide: 180 mm or more ix. Load Capacity: 200 Kgs x. Drive: Electro-hydraulic xi. Power supply: 220V AC - 50 Hz Standard Accessories: i. Radio-translucent Arm Support: One pair ii. PU Foam Mattress - 50 mm: One Set iii. Restraint Body Strap: 2 pcs iv. Catheter Extension Board v. AV Fistula Board. Warranty: Five years warranty with all spare parts and after th at CMC quoted for Five years annually. · All Accessories should be covered in warranty atleast for two years from the date of installation. · Price should be quoted separately for all accessories and freeze for next five years . · Physical demonstration of the quoted equipment in bid must be at GIPMER before technical evaluation committee .
